comparison.objective: Mechanically attach a rack rail versus transport a three-box stack to a shelf without separating it.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated-rail regrasping, compliant insertion and fastening versus bilateral squeeze transport and stack stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Persistent prong-and-screw attachment at one rack unit versus an intact, centered standing stack on the shelf.
comparison.reason: Shared large-object bimanual support does not make load-preserving transport equivalent to mechanical installation. Candidate overload limits remain unspecified.
